rationale.oversight-theater: Defines ineffective nominal oversight through absent power, access, control, or intent.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Makes genuine intervention, override, reversal, and stop authority essential.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Treats understandability, interpretability, and traceability as necessary epistemic support.
rationale.automation-bias: Analyzes capable overseers’ overreliance, complacency, and attention failures.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Evaluates its effectiveness conditions against EU AI Act Article 14.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes both wholesale oversight dismissal and uncritical regulatory mandates.
